headline: V26-3332: make Linear work the way Jira does

V26-3269.title: Post a delivery's Linear updates and moves from a publisher, not by hand

criteria.text: With the Linear adapter configured, a delivery's lane.assigned, hand-off, merge and decision entries post to Linear with no lead action, and each is in the ledger once

A 429, a 5xx or a GraphQL rate-limit or authentication error stops the run and the next run retries from there; a forbidden error is decided by site_refuses(); any other error writes failed and shows in Needs you
A ticket already in the target status is recorded as the existing skip outcome (the lead's recorded reading of AC3), with its update posted once and no duplicate comment
No output, log or ledger line contains the API key
A marked comment posted through the adapter is read back by markers --ticket against real Linear, recorded on the item

V26-3334.title: Remove the host publisher mode: every tracker posts through the tracker publisher

criteria.text: A binding naming a host publisher fails validation, and doctor and lead-init name the fix
A Linear-snapshot binding with the tracker publisher and no tracker settings posts through the Linear adapter
No shipped skill, reference or script carries the host mode's tokens, ack is refused as an unknown command, and pins hold both
A record opened under host mode reopens under the new generation with no outbox item and no re-post
tracker.updates manual still prints the start, post and review moves for people to make

V26-3342.title: Repair main: give V26-3269's solution notes the corpus's note shape, and select the corpus check for notes
V26-3342.why: fullHealth failed at c16bded, V26-3269's merge, on tests.test_compound_learning_corpus; the base-broken rules repair forward and close the gap (Decision 10).

criteria.text: Both of V26-3269's solution notes pass tests.test_compound_learning_corpus and keep what each teaches
The binding's selection.readers maps docs/solutions/* to tests.test_compound_learning_corpus, so select adds it for any change to a note, with any readers pin updated
It lands through the queue and fullHealth passes on the new base, journaling base.repaired

V26-3339.title: Make the lead choose a candidate's checks, or the full suite, when accepting it

criteria.text: Under selection.lead, lead-accept with neither --checks nor --full-suite refuses, records nothing, and prints a proposed --checks from the diff and the hand-off's named checks
lead-accept --checks records the selection at the handed head through select, refusing what select refuses, and the queue runs it
lead-accept --full-suite accepts on the fallback and journals it as the lead's decision
handoff --checks takes catalogue ids, refuses an unknown one, and shows them in the hand-off message and the record
While a candidate checks on the fallback under selection.lead, the supervisor's status line and the live view's checking panel say so, naming the fallback
A binding without selection.lead accepts exactly as before

V26-3339.why: The operator's ruling of 2026-11-10, "close the gap in this run": V26-3097 checked on the full suite because the lead's acceptance never asked for a check selection (Decision 9).

V26-3333.title: Post this repository's own deliveries' Linear updates through the tracker publisher

criteria.text: After the switch, the first new journal entry posts to Linear with no lead action, with its ledger line, marked Linear comment and a real markers --ticket read linked on the item
Nothing the host outbox already held is posted again
run_delivery.py doctor passes on the switched configuration

V26-3097.title: Widen what the Linear qualifier's transport sensor proves

criteria.text: A planted instruction to reach Linear another way, in a Linear SKILL.md or references file, fails the qualifier
A Linear skill moved out of the linear profile, with catalog and profiles changed together, fails naming the skill, and an empty delta fails
The qualifier's result states that it proves the Linear skills reach Linear only through the host

V26-3083.title: Run the on-demand Linear connector check on a schedule

criteria.text: The check runs weekly with no one starting it, recorded by its first scheduled run
A failure reaches the owner within a day, shown by a deliberately failing run's notification
A run leaves no open entity, its issues canceled and found only canceled by its marker (the lead's recorded reading of AC3)

V26-3343.title: Make the connector check's marker searches count only issues that carry the marker
V26-3343.why: V26-3083's first deliberate failing run found Linear's search matches loosely, so step 1's 'expecting nothing' and the cleanup search could miscount (Decision 11).

criteria.text: The on-demand steps and the routine prompt say a match is an issue carrying the run's marker, in step 1, step 3 and the cleanup search
The doc's exact pins are updated, each proven red by a mutant

outOfScope: V26-2947, a release-set tracking item from before tag-driven releases, and V26-1592, which is Athena's repository.
Any change to how agents themselves reach Linear: `linear-tracker-adapter`, `create-linear-ticket` and `execute-linear-ticket` stay MCP-only.
A Linear write path anywhere but run-delivery's tracker publisher and the commands that already post through a tracker adapter.
`tracker.updates: manual`, which stays: a tracker with no adapter, by the adopter's choice, has its moves made by people.
A final (non-candidate) release. The candidate is promoted at a later batch boundary, as `docs/product-generation.md` says.

outcome.summary: Linear updates post themselves, the way Jira's do.
outcome.text: run-delivery's tracker publisher posts Linear updates and moves through Linear's API, host mode is gone, this repository's deliveries use it, the Linear qualifier covers the agent-facing documents, and the connector check runs weekly.
